(Currently Amended) A method of selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising the steps of: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __wherein the information is added prior to transmission of the locator to the client computer__; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the unique signature is embedded within the locator and is not derived solely from the resource identifier itself__.
